label: Halloween · last minute
headline: 5 scary-good Halloween gifts you can still grab
sub: Daft, spooky and renter-friendly – nothing stuck to the walls.

tips.title: Skeleton fairy lights
tips.text: Tiny skulls on a battery string. Drape over a shelf and the bedroom's a haunted house.

tips.title: A realistic fake spider
tips.text: Big, hairy, rubber. Leave it in the bath and wait for the scream.

tips.title: Gross-out sweets
tips.text: Gummy eyeballs, jelly brains, ghost-faced marshmallows – gross (or cute) in the best way.

tips.title: A horror party game
tips.text: Turns a Halloween night in into an actual event.

tips.title: A pumpkin carving kit
tips.text: Supermarket pumpkin + tools + a battery tea light = instant scary face.

caption:
